title: William and Sarah Glasgow to Solomon Cowell,25 December 1782,Deed Book 5 pp. 135–136

citations.name: William Glasgow
citations.type: William and Sarah Glasgow to Solomon Cowell,25 December 1782,Deed Book 5 pp. 135–136
citations.place: Currituck County, North Carolina, United States
citations.assertion: Seller William Glasgow, expressly husband of Sarah; no literal father clause.. William and Sarah sold approximately 50 acres for£4 specie to Solomon Cowell. Original continuation gives the same full Dauge-corner survey as 1761. Witnesses Thomas Cooper and John Glasgow; they are not given kin roles. Acknowledged March Term 1786, registered 25 April 1786. Estate of inheritance in fee simple is generic tenure wording. The father clause above belongs to a different Sanderson deed; the Isaac/Caleb instrument below is unrelated. William Glasgow: Seller William Glasgow, expressly husband of Sarah; no literal father clause.; Sarah Glascow: Sarah, expressly William’s wife; Cooper maiden surname and maternity not supplied by this deed.; Caleb Glasgow: Earlier Caleb purchaser supplies comparative parcel context only, not a named 1782 party.; Caleb Glasgow: Compatible alternative account of the earlier Caleb purchaser; no new identity selection. Reviewed 2026-10-31; Original image receipts in tmp/currituck-357-originals-20261031; raw scans preserved privately, not published.
